cards.name: Card back
cards.prompt:
STYLE: a full-colour esoteric tarot card BACK design, vertical portrait composition, the whole card visible edge to edge. Original artwork inspired by the symbolism of the Thoth Tarot tradition of Aleister Crowley and the Golden Dawn, not a copy of any existing deck or painting. Painted in opaque gouache and tempera with a visionary, early-20th-century occult art-deco sensibility: projective geometry, interpenetrating translucent planes, prismatic rays of light, crystalline facets, sacred geometry underlying the composition. Rich, saturated, luminous colour with jewel tones and subtle gradients, soft inner glow, fine visible brush texture, crisp clean outlines; no photographic realism, no 3D render look. The card has the SAME border as every face of this deck: a thin double gold frame (outer line 1.5% of the width, inner hairline) on a very dark indigo margin (#0d0a1a) about 4% of the card width all around, with small eight-pointed gold stars in the four corners. Sharp details, high resolution, print quality.

THE DESIGN: a perfectly symmetrical, perfectly centred ornamental design, mirror-identical left to right. The ground is a deep radial gradient from near-black indigo (#0d0a1a) at the edges to rich violet (#2c1f5c) at the centre, covered by a faint regular lattice of tiny gold dots. Dead centre, large, spanning about 70% of the card width: a luminous ring made of two concentric gold circles with a narrow band between them carrying a delicate running pattern of tiny gold diamonds and eight-pointed stars. Inside the ring, the UNICURSAL HEXAGRAM of Thelema: a six-pointed star drawn as one single continuous closed line that crosses itself (not two separate interlocked triangles), one point upward, in polished bright gold (#f1d68e) with a soft glow. At the exact centre of the hexagram, a five-petalled ROSE seen from above, its petals rose red (#e0707a) outlined in gold, with a small golden heart at its centre. Behind the hexagram, fine straight gold rays and interpenetrating translucent violet planes radiate outward like a crystalline sunburst, fading toward the border. Above and below the central emblem, two mirror-identical ornaments, each a row of three small eight-pointed gold stars joined by a thin gold rule, placed symmetrically at the same distance from the top and bottom frame. In the space between the emblem and the corners, faint interlacing arcs of sacred geometry in dim gold (Flower-of-Life-like petals), subtle, never competing with the central emblem. Bold, simple, high contrast: the hexagram and the rose must stay clearly recognisable when the card is shrunk to a thumbnail 60 pixels wide.

NO TEXT: no letters, no words, no numbers, no captions, no signature anywhere; only geometric symbols. No people, no animals, no faces.
cards.negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, words, captions, watermark, signature, logo, photograph, photorealistic, 3D render, CGI, anime, cartoon, comic style, flat vector clip art, asymmetric, off-centre, lopsided, figures, faces, people, animals, hands, modern objects, cropped frame, missing border, different border style, border without stars, low resolution, blurry, jpeg artifacts, cluttered noisy background, gore, horror
